summary: DeFi Development Corp. filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing a treasury update rather than a special-situations event. The Company reported its SOL and SOL-equivalent holdings grew by 55,491 tokens, from 2,333,432 as of August 27, 2026 to 2,388,923 as of September 11, 2026, a 2% increase. A press release was furnished as Exhibit 99.1, and no board recommendation, advisor, price, premium or transaction mechanics were disclosed. The filing is a periodic crypto-treasury disclosure, not a deal; watch staking deployment and token-price exposure.
